info.headline: Notify NYC - Silver Alert - Uriel Fuzaylov (QN)
info.description:
Silver Alert issued 10-20-2026 at 05:50 AM.
A Silver Alert has been issued for Uriel Fuzaylov, an 84-year-old White Male, last seen near Kissena Boulevard and 72nd Road in Queens at approximately 9:30 PM on 10-19-2026. Uriel has medical conditions, may seem disoriented, and may be in need of medical attention.
Description: Uriel has white hair. He was last seen wearing a black hooded sweatshirt, black pants and a camouflage green baseball cap.
If you see Uriel, please call 1-800-577-8477 (TIPS) or 9-1-1.
A photo of Uriel is available here: https://flic.kr/p/2sHhFRG
